stage: UCM数量诊断下的随机采样与三奖励继续短训对照

rollout.tool: actual scene_classify, registered tool calls only, role-separated feedback
rollout.state: same last valid decoding-step final-layer final-position hidden tensor is cached and passed to frozen scorer; no terminal forward-state replacement
rollout.quality: nonempty completed answer, no generated result tags, no mixed/unknown tool calls, no addCriterion, no token-limit or round-limit; failures retained
rollout.format_reward: 0.2 exactly when new rollout quality passes, otherwise 0.0; stricter than historical regex-only bonus
rollout.sampling_distribution: untruncated categorical softmax; first-token EOS suppression from min_new_tokens=1 is identically applied in policy logprob
rollout.tool_boundary_stop: complete scene_classify closing tag only; answers end on native configured EOS

pilot.selection: first by fixed priority with strict completed+consumed feedback>=90%, consumed tool>=95%, generated result tags<=2%; train8 protocol only, utilities not used
pilot.signal: all3 reward group variances and tie patterns reported; no reward selection by validation
pilot.if_no_prompt_passes: preserve fullpilot, no training; report protocol failure and matched reward diagnostics

readout.proxy_library: all1680 train images, CLIP encode_image with zero16x1024 prompts once, train-row aligned; noAgentprior for library
readout.context: same frozen backbone/translation for all3rewards; original ranking formula reconstructed on this checkpoint, historicalversion0 not recovered

training.optimizer: AdamW fresh per arm, same balanced32 initialization
training.loss: negative group-mean standardized reward advantage times summed effective assistant token log probability; recompute per round, backward serially
training.zero_variance_policy: std<=1e-8: retain group, skip optimizer entirely, count attempt and zero informative update; no synthetic reward jitter; differences in effective updates explicitly limit reward-only causal comparison
training.checkpoint: fixed final32attempts, intermediate16; no val selection

probability_gate.failure: save bounded witness and stop before substantive updates

evaluation.primary: B all-count hard accuracy macro1to4 on52 count1to4 cases among55train images outside8policytraining images
secondary: B/A pair and hard accuracy/margins all85 labelled quantity images
stochastic protocol and within-image reward/utility rank patterns
evaluation.baseline_greedy_reuse: only if chosen contract_only and exact warm state+feature replay; re-score on same frozenreadout; no fresh test scoring

analysis.quantity_unit: paired image, stratify truecounts1to4; compare all reward arms and baseline
analysis.scope: one continuation seed, eight policytraining images, val-selected frozenreadout; original three-dataset RFPO comparison remains a separate experiment

adoption.primary: quantity_hard minus proxy_rank B hard macro CI lower>0, hard minus pair also reported
adoption.retrieval_guard: val mR hard minus baseline CI lower>-0.02
adoption.protocol_guard: all finalpolicies stochastic strict>=90% and generated result<=2%
adoption.training_guard: same32actual updates across3arms for strict matched-update claim; otherwise report opportunity-budget mechanisms only
adoption.if_not_met: retain checkpoints and report completed negative/uncertain comparison; no automatic extended training

report_node: pilot+probability contract+three frozen-scoring continuationarms+unified heldout evaluation+independent reconstruction+dual backups+GitHub
